title: Empty Nester with empty nests
description:
💙 Welcome to Garrett’s Blue Room, a cozy upstairs retreat once my son’s room. Your private room has Wi-Fi and a lock. The bathroom may be shared with the Pink Room guest. Enjoy the kitchen, living area, and back deck. 🏡 Our neighborhood offers trails, seasonal pools, pickleball, and basketball. We’re 10 minutes from Old Hickory Lake and 15 minutes from downtown Nashville. Need another room? Book the Pink Room:
https://www.airbnb.com/h/paytonspinkroom

The space
🏡 This spacious Hendersonville home features a cozy shared living area with an 82-inch TV and gas fireplace, a welcoming kitchen, and a back deck overlooking the woods.

🌳 The quiet neighborhood offers sidewalks, walking trails, two seasonal pools, pickleball courts, and basketball courts. Deer, rabbits, and other wildlife frequently visit the backyard. Old Hickory Lake is approximately 10 minutes away, and downtown Nashville is about 15 minutes away.

Guest access
🔑 You’ll have your own private bedroom upstairs, and I hope you’ll feel completely at home during your stay. Please feel welcome to use the kitchen, relax in the living room, or enjoy the back deck overlooking the woods.

The upstairs bathroom is shared only if the Pink Room is also occupied. ❤️

During your stay
🔑 Guest interactions are entirely up to you. I’m happy to chat and offer local recommendations, but I’ll also respect your privacy and give you as much space as you’d like during your stay.
